author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Position Boosted by Financial Consulate Inc.
text:
Financial Consulate Inc. increased its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6.0% during the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 30,862 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 1,742 shares during the period. Apple comprises 2.9% of Financial Consulate Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 7th biggest position. Financial Consulate Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $5,713,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently bought and sold shares of the stock. Pegasus Partners Ltd. lifted its stake in Apple by 0.6% during the 2nd quarter. Pegasus Partners Ltd. now owns 43,980 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,141,000 after acquiring an additional 277 shares in the last quarter. Palisade Asset Management LLC raised its position in Apple by 3.6% in the 2nd quarter. Palisade Asset Management LLC now owns 91,475 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $16,933,000 after purchasing an additional 3,155 shares in the last quarter. Abacus Planning Group Inc. raised its position in Apple by 0.8% in the 2nd quarter. Abacus Planning Group Inc. now owns 61,956 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $11,468,000 after purchasing an additional 466 shares in the last quarter. Allen Capital Group LLC raised its position in Apple by 6.1% in the 2nd quarter. Allen Capital Group LLC now owns 17,644 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,266,000 after purchasing an additional 1,020 shares in the last quarter. Finally, AdvisorNet Financial Inc raised its position in Apple by 24.1% in the 2nd quarter. AdvisorNet Financial Inc now owns 55,149 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,209,000 after purchasing an additional 10,714 shares in the last quarter. 58.44% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
